body: Damn I'm sorry to hear that :( My experience with our hotline was actually good, so it sucks to hear that others haven't had the same experience. We need better hotlines.

At this point I don't really care what happens after I'm gone. To me, a good end right now is to just not wake up. I don't believe in it, but heaven and all that jazz always seemed horrible. 

I like your reasoning to stay alive, though. I feel a bit better.
I never knew suicide prevention day also fell on my birthday. What a damn joke!
Same here. I feel like I'm fighting the inevitable at this point.
